title: Orizn Visa Checker
shortdesc: Check visa requirements between any two countries — 39,585 pairs in 15 languages
desc:
Orizn Visa API provides instant access to visa requirements for 39,585 passport-destination pairs (199 x 199 countries) in 15 languages. Data sourced from 136 official government sources.

Endpoints:
- quickVisaCheck: Quick yes/no check (no API key needed)
- getFullVisaDetails: Full details with documents, process, tips (API key required)
- getCoverageStats: Coverage statistics (no API key needed)

Authentication: Custom header x-api-key
Get your key at https://visa.orizn.app
author: Orizn
